objective: Qualify scene-grouped Haze4K development evidence, fixed-baseline local restoration errors, bounded oracle headroom, proxy learnability, and only then a trainable spatial restoration module without using official-test candidate outcomes during development.

source_anchors.reference: Official ConvIR-B base graph and haze4k-base.pkl SHA-256 6f42037d57a4e3de3a10ac0ab909d66a3415864a19433c29204a975f4efa4088
Frozen 32-pixel tile, paired-GT demand, signed RGB projection, materiality, and scene-grouped aggregation definitions from the new-route SOTS/OTS measurement series

haze4k_train_data_integrity.core_assumption: Haze4K train can be paired and grouped by canonical clear content without accessing the official test split.
haze4k_train_data_integrity.close_condition: Close after the frozen scene-grouping assumption is tested; reopen only with independently archived scene-identity evidence.

haze4k_baseline_local_error.core_assumption: Fixed official ConvIR-B predictions on Haze4K internal-development scenes contain stable material local restoration errors measurable at clear-scene level.
haze4k_baseline_local_error.close_condition: Close if preregistered local error prevalence or scene-level repeatability fails the frozen measurement gates.

haze4k_local_action_oracle.core_assumption: A bounded non-deployable keep, weaken, or strengthen action oracle has material scene-level headroom over uniform adjustment.
haze4k_local_action_oracle.close_condition: Close if bounded spatial actions do not improve the frozen primary estimand while satisfying tail-harm gates.

haze4k_local_action_proxy.core_assumption: Input or intermediate features can predict bounded local restoration actions or harm risk under scene-grouped cross-validation.
haze4k_local_action_proxy.close_condition: Close if grouped out-of-fold prediction fails utility and calibration gates against shuffled and spatially uniform controls.

bounded_spatial_restoration_module.core_assumption: A learnable network-internal bounded spatial regulator can exploit qualified local state and risk signals beyond parameter-matched spatially uniform controls.
bounded_spatial_restoration_module.close_condition: Close if fair module variants cannot improve scene-level restoration quality without violating frozen harm limits.

haze4k_candidate_confirmation.core_assumption: A completely frozen candidate can improve the candidate-unseen Haze4K official test relative to the official baseline.
haze4k_candidate_confirmation.close_condition: Close after the single frozen candidate confirmation use regardless of terminal decision.

nh_haze_external_validation.core_assumption: A Haze4K-confirmed frozen candidate retains directionally consistent utility and bounded tail harm on untouched NH-HAZE images.
nh_haze_external_validation.close_condition: Close after the single sealed NH-HAZE evaluation regardless of terminal decision.

amendments.reason: The archived 750-scene split closeout passed and explicitly authorizes fixed-official-weight baseline local-error measurement on the 150 internal-development scenes.
amendments.approved_scope: Open only the Haze4K baseline local-error family for its first adjacent development-screening measurement.
